title: Authoritative 420Explorer Genesis requirement inventory

requirements.name: block
requirements.statement: 420Explorer must provide the "block" Genesis view.

requirements.name: transaction
requirements.statement: 420Explorer must provide the "transaction" Genesis view.

requirements.name: receipt/logs
requirements.statement: 420Explorer must provide the "receipt/logs" Genesis view.

requirements.name: address
requirements.statement: 420Explorer must provide the "address" Genesis view.

requirements.name: contract
requirements.statement: 420Explorer must provide the "contract" Genesis view.

requirements.name: token/asset activity
requirements.statement: 420Explorer must provide the "token/asset activity" Genesis view.

requirements.name: validator
requirements.statement: 420Explorer must provide the "validator" Genesis view.

requirements.name: epoch/rotation
requirements.statement: 420Explorer must provide the "epoch/rotation" Genesis view.

requirements.name: protocol service/version
requirements.statement: 420Explorer must provide the "protocol service/version" Genesis view.

requirements.name: network status
requirements.statement: 420Explorer must provide the "network status" Genesis view.

requirements.name: GENESIS_USER_APP classification
requirements.statement: 420Explorer is a GENESIS_USER_APP and its frontend remains non-consensus-critical.

requirements.name: Explorer-specific contracts not required
requirements.statement: 420Explorer must require no Explorer-specific Genesis contract.

requirements.name: Explorer is not canonical state authority
requirements.statement: 420Explorer must not claim canonical protocol state authority.

requirements.name: 420Indexer chain index
requirements.statement: Explorer indexed chain data must come from the 420Indexer /v1 read API.

requirements.name: No direct execution RPC ingestion
requirements.statement: Explorer must not ingest execution RPC directly as an independent chain-indexing path.

requirements.name: Consensus projection source
requirements.statement: Explorer consensus/finality data must be presented from qualified 420Indexer consensus projections.

requirements.name: Registry-backed protocol discovery
requirements.statement: Protocol service/version discovery must use the 420Indexer Registry-backed projection.

requirements.name: 420 Names display enrichment
requirements.statement: 420 Names may enrich presentation but must not replace canonical address/protocol identity.

requirements.name: 420 Identity public display enrichment
requirements.statement: 420 Identity may enrich public presentation but must not replace canonical identity/address records.

requirements.name: Indexer service identity
requirements.statement: Explorer must consume the 420Indexer service.

requirements.name: Indexer API version v1
requirements.statement: Explorer must consume the v1 Indexer API contract.

requirements.name: Required chain ID 420
requirements.statement: Explorer must require chain ID 420 and fail closed on wrong-network data.

requirements.name: independentChainIngestion
requirements.statement: Explorer must not implement independent chain ingestion.

requirements.name: independentCheckpointStore
requirements.statement: Explorer must not implement an independent checkpoint store.

requirements.name: independentReorgEngine
requirements.statement: Explorer must not implement an independent reorg engine.

requirements.name: independentProtocolDecoderRegistry
requirements.statement: Explorer must not implement an independent protocol decoder registry.

requirements.name: Fail closed on canonical-authority claim
requirements.statement: Explorer must fail closed if the Indexer claims canonical authority.

requirements.name: /v1/health
requirements.statement: The Explorer Indexer consumer contract must support /v1/health.

requirements.name: /v1/blocks
requirements.statement: The Explorer Indexer consumer contract must support /v1/blocks.

requirements.name: /v1/blocks/{number}
requirements.statement: The Explorer Indexer consumer contract must support /v1/blocks/{number}.

requirements.name: /v1/transactions/{hash}
requirements.statement: The Explorer Indexer consumer contract must support /v1/transactions/{hash}.

requirements.name: /v1/receipts/{hash}
requirements.statement: The Explorer Indexer consumer contract must support /v1/receipts/{hash}.

requirements.name: /v1/blocks/{number}/logs
requirements.statement: The Explorer Indexer consumer contract must support /v1/blocks/{number}/logs.

requirements.name: /v1/services/{service}/versions/{version}
requirements.statement: The Explorer Indexer consumer contract must support /v1/services/{service}/versions/{version}.

requirements.name: canonicalKey
requirements.statement: Indexed canonical identity must be keyed by chain ID and block hash.

requirements.name: tracksHeadSafeFinalizedSeparately
requirements.statement: Head, safe and finalized states must be tracked separately.

requirements.name: reorgsAllowedOnlyAboveFinality
requirements.statement: Reorg repair may rewrite only non-finalized history.

requirements.name: finalizedHistoryImmutable
requirements.statement: Finalized indexed history must remain immutable absent explicit chain-level finality failure handling.

requirements.name: rebuildableFromChain
requirements.statement: The Explorer index must be rebuildable from canonical sources.

requirements.name: databaseIsNonCanonical
requirements.statement: Indexer database contents must remain explicitly non-canonical.

requirements.name: implementedBy
requirements.statement: Indexing responsibility belongs to 420Indexer, not Explorer.

requirements.name: showRuntimeCodeHash
requirements.statement: Contract views must show runtime code hash.

requirements.name: showRegistryServiceAndVersion
requirements.statement: Contract/protocol views must expose Registry service/version where applicable.

requirements.name: showManifestCommitmentWhenRegistered
requirements.statement: Registered components must expose manifest commitment when available.

requirements.name: verifiedSourceIsPresentationMetadata
requirements.statement: Verified-source information is presentation metadata, not execution authority.

requirements.name: sourceVerificationCannotOverrideRuntimeBytecode
requirements.statement: Source-verification metadata must never override deployed runtime bytecode.

requirements.name: EXP-INV-001
requirements.statement: 420Explorer owns no canonical protocol state and requires no Explorer-specific Genesis contract.

requirements.name: EXP-INV-002
requirements.statement: Explorer records are projections of chain, consensus and registered protocol state; conflicts resolve in favor of canonical chain data.

requirements.name: EXP-INV-003
requirements.statement: Head, safe and finalized states are displayed distinctly and are never collapsed into one confirmation status.

requirements.name: EXP-INV-004
requirements.statement: Reorg repair may rewrite only non-finalized indexed history; finalized history is immutable absent an explicit chain-level finality failure procedure.

requirements.name: EXP-INV-005
requirements.statement: The complete Explorer index can be rebuilt from supported nodes/RPC, receipts, logs, consensus metadata and registry reads through 420Indexer without trusting the hosted Explorer database.

requirements.name: EXP-INV-006
requirements.statement: Contract decoding uses runtime bytecode and versioned 420Registry commitments projected by 420Indexer; labels and verified-source metadata cannot change execution truth.

requirements.name: EXP-INV-007
requirements.statement: 420 Names and 420 Identity labels are display enrichments only and never replace the underlying address or canonical identity record.

requirements.name: EXP-INV-008
requirements.statement: Explorer failure or unavailability cannot prevent direct wallet, RPC, contract or protocol interaction.

requirements.name: EXP-INV-009
requirements.statement: Explorer operators gain no custody, smart-account execution, governance, bridge, validator or token-transfer authority.

requirements.name: EXP-INV-010
requirements.statement: Public APIs/indexers are replaceable and must expose chain identifiers and indexed/finalized heights so clients can detect stale or wrong-network data.

requirements.name: EXP-INV-011
requirements.statement: Transaction, receipt, event and balance presentation must remain traceable to canonical block hashes and chain ID.

requirements.name: EXP-INV-012
requirements.statement: Privacy-sensitive off-chain payloads are not made canonical merely because a hash, commitment or transaction reference is visible in Explorer.

requirements.name: EXP-INV-013
requirements.statement: 420Explorer consumes 420Indexer for indexed chain/protocol data and MUST NOT implement an independent RPC ingestion, checkpoint, reorg or protocol-decoder pipeline.

requirements.name: governance view
requirements.statement: The frozen application purpose names governance, but the dedicated Explorer profile does not list a governance requiredView; this must remain an explicit scope decision until reconciled.
notes: Do not silently add or remove a governance view in EXP-0.3.1.

requirements.name: staking/reward-specific activity view
requirements.statement: A dedicated staking/reward activity workflow is non-blocking and outside the agreed core requiredViews unless scope is explicitly changed.
notes: Validator and epoch/rotation required views remain mandatory; this entry concerns dedicated staking/reward history only.

requirements.name: 420 Verify-backed source presentation
requirements.statement: A 420 Verify-backed source-verification presentation integration is non-blocking for raw contract inspection unless scope is explicitly changed.

scope_rules: Every dedicated-profile requiredView is mandatory Genesis scope.
Dedicated-profile Indexer consumer, indexing, verification-boundary and invariant requirements are mandatory even when they are architectural rather than user-visible.
420 Names and 420 Identity are optional display enrichments and cannot block core Genesis qualification.
Post-Genesis enhancements cannot become mandatory without an explicit authoritative scope change.
The governance-view conflict remains scope_decision_required until the broad frozen application purpose and dedicated Explorer profile are explicitly reconciled.
Frozen system-address assignments are authority/configuration evidence, not proof of target-network deployment.
